patterns.name: KPI card with a sparkline and delta
patterns.selectorNote: second link-card in the grid of six KPI tiles directly under the greeting header; the tile with a compact trend line
patterns.notes: Tiles in the strip differ by inline visual: ring gauge, trend line, segmented bar, equalizer bar, stacked bar, event dots. The label row pairs an uppercase mono caption with a muted qualifier on the right. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: KPI card with a ring gauge
patterns.selectorNote: first tile of the KPI strip on the home route
patterns.notes: Gauge replaces the sparkline; the value sits centred inside the arc and a footnote runs below. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: KPI card with a segmented progress bar
patterns.selectorNote: third tile of the KPI strip on the home route
patterns.notes: A thin multi-segment bar carries target and commit; axis captions sit under it in mono type. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: Decision card with an inline preview pane
patterns.selectorNote: second article in the primary column of the home route (the first is the emphasised one)
patterns.notes: Two-column grid: actor line, question title, linked record and facts on the left; a recessed preview or chart panel on the right; action row of one filled, one outlined and one ghost button below. The first card of the list is emphasised with an accent outline instead of a border. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: Agent profile card with a stats panel
patterns.selectorNote: first article in the three-column card grid on the crew route
patterns.notes: Header with avatar, name, status and a menu; a 2x2 recessed stat panel (each cell: mono caption, large figure, small inline visual); a status line; a three-way segmented control; a one-line description. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: Data table header row
patterns.selectorNote: the header row of the only table on the companies route
patterns.notes: Sticky, same fill as the surface, no divider colour contrast beyond a hairline; sortable columns show a small arrow. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface.

patterns.name: Data table body row
patterns.selectorNote: second body row of the table on the companies route
patterns.notes: Cells: selection checkbox, entity chip with avatar, stage pill, owner chip, right-aligned figure, health meter with delta, last-touch chip, linked next step with date. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface.

patterns.name: Work board column
patterns.selectorNote: first section on the work route that opens with a header element
patterns.notes: Header: status glyph, title, count, right-aligned summary figures; cards stack with a small gap; the column scrolls on its own. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Work board card
patterns.selectorNote: first card inside the first board column of the work route
patterns.notes: Actor and type line, title, linked record, status line with icon. Variants add a progress bar or an inline preview. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: Deal pipeline column
patterns.selectorNote: first board column on the deals route (board view is the default)
patterns.notes: Header adds a stage glyph, an aggregate amount and a thin progress bar under the title row. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Deal card
patterns.selectorNote: first link-card of the first column on the deals route
patterns.notes: Title and amount on one row, subtitle with a status qualifier, then a health meter, owner chip and date, then a divider and a one-line next step. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: Record timeline event
patterns.selectorNote: first list item of the ordered timeline in the record detail route
patterns.notes: Avatar on a vertical rail, a bold actor plus sentence line with a right-aligned mono time, a muted body line, an evidence chip row. Day group labels separate runs. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Activity stream item
patterns.selectorNote: first entry of the second panel in the right-hand column of the home route
patterns.notes: Actor avatar, a one-line sentence with a trailing relative time, and a second line with a record chip and muted context. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Meeting list item
patterns.selectorNote: first entry of the first panel in the right-hand column of the home route
patterns.notes: Time and duration stack on the left, a title row with record chip and a relative pill, a subtitle, a status on the right. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Search input
patterns.selectorNote: first text input in the toolbar above the table on the companies route
patterns.notes: Recessed fill, leading icon, trailing keyboard hint, no visible border at rest. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: sunken.

patterns.name: List toolbar
patterns.selectorNote: the flex row that holds the search input, the filter button and the sort and group controls
patterns.notes: One row of 28 px controls with 8 px gaps; right-aligned secondary controls. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Sidebar navigation item
patterns.selectorNote: the sidebar link whose path is the current route (active state)
patterns.notes: Leading icon, label, optional trailing count; active state is a raised fill, no accent bar. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: sunken.

patterns.name: Sidebar navigation item, idle
patterns.selectorNote: a sidebar link that is not the current route
patterns.notes: Same anatomy as the active item with a muted label and no fill. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Empty / invitation tile
patterns.selectorNote: the one non-card tile in the agent card grid
patterns.notes: Dashed or flat tile with a row of four glyph buttons, a title, one muted sentence and a secondary button; centred. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Page header
patterns.selectorNote: the grandparent of the primary heading on the work route
patterns.notes: Large headline plus a one-line summary with inline emphasis; a right-aligned live-status line. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Record header with avatar and facts
patterns.selectorNote: the block three levels above the primary heading on the record detail route
patterns.notes: Large avatar tile, title with two small badges, a mono domain plus facts line; right side holds owner chip, link button and primary action. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Record stat strip
patterns.selectorNote: the four-cell grid under the record header (grandparent of the stage stepper)
patterns.notes: Four cells divided by 1 px gaps over a faint fill; a full-width next-step row sits below. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: sunken.

patterns.name: Record stat cell
patterns.selectorNote: the first cell of the record stat strip (holds the stage stepper)
patterns.notes: Mono uppercase caption, then the figure or stepper; qualifier text right-aligned on the caption row. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: Side panel card with list
patterns.selectorNote: second section of the right-hand column on the record detail route
patterns.notes: Header row with title, count and an action glyph; list items are 8 px-radius rows with leading avatar, title, meta line and trailing glyph. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface-raised.

patterns.name: Segmented control
patterns.selectorNote: first radio group on the record detail route (the timeline filter)
patterns.notes: Recessed track with 2 px inset, selected segment raised; 24 px segments, 6 px radius. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: sunken.

patterns.name: List view tabs
patterns.selectorNote: the first tab list on the companies route (the view tabs with counts)
patterns.notes: Underline tabs with a trailing count; the active tab carries a 2 px bar and brighter label. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.

patterns.name: Stage pill
patterns.selectorNote: the pill inside the first data cell (the stage column) of the first table row
patterns.notes: Tinted fill, 20 px high, 6 px radius, leading mini bar-glyph encoding the stage. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: sunken.

patterns.name: Primary action button
patterns.selectorNote: first button inside the first decision card
patterns.notes: Filled with the accent; trailing key-hint glyph. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: accent-fill.

patterns.name: Secondary action button
patterns.selectorNote: second button inside the first decision card
patterns.notes: Outlined, transparent fill, leading icon. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: surface.

patterns.name: Ghost action button
patterns.selectorNote: third button inside the first decision card
patterns.notes: No fill, no border, muted label. Light scheme changes colour only; geometry is identical. Light background role: transparent.
